description:
Why 1 Mosquito Bite Itches in 3 Seconds! — You lose 3 seconds before 1 tiny mosquito spits saliva inside your skin!
Kids science answer for "why mosquito bites itch for kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Only female mosquitoes bite for egg protein. Their saliva keeps blood flowing without clotting; your immune system releases histamine, causing the red itchy bump.
